Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single premium miniature 3D satin-clay offer illustration for a mobile AI chat limited-time-offer notice, displayed at 24 logical pixels.
Primary request: exactly ONE isolated DISCOUNT COUPON TICKET with a broad raised ivory percentage sign, instantly conveying a special offer instead of a model or character identity.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, square canvas, no background tile or ground plane.
Subject/composition: one chunky rounded coupon, gently tilted about 12 degrees counterclockwise and viewed almost front-on with a very slight three-quarter perspective so its thick soft edge is visible. Clear semicircular notch cut into the middle of both short sides. Center the whole ticket, occupy about 88% of the square while keeping every edge inside the canvas with a clean transparent margin. The silhouette must remain bold and readable at 24px.
Style/materials: polished original 3D satin-clay illustration, broad smooth sculpted forms, soft matte/satin surfaces, subtle bevels and restrained highlights, matching a refined collection of small friendly 3D model-avatar illustrations. Warm soft studio key light, gentle ambient occlusion confined to the object. Not a flat line icon.
Color palette: blush pink #FF9CD5 flowing softly into warm coral/apricot orange #FF8652, creamy ivory raised percentage symbol. Pink on the left, orange on the right. No purple, violet, blue or metallic gold.
Graphic mark: one large simple ivory percent mark centered on the ticket face, made from two thick circular dots and one thick rounded diagonal bar. It should be the only symbol. No discount amount, no numerals, no letters, no writing, no price, no logo, no watermark.
Avoid: animals, faces, mascots, candy, gift boxes, extra tickets, extra badges, ribbons, sparkles, floating debris, busy perforation microdetails, scenery, border, opaque square or oval behind the object, floor shadow, glow halo.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production mobile membership-page background art, a single tall portrait image, approximately 9:20 aspect ratio (1080 x 2400 if possible), fully opaque, no UI.
Input image 1 is a MOOD AND COMPOSITION reference screenshot only: use its tender nearly-kissing adult couple, luminous violet romantic atmosphere and elegant refracted light. Do not reproduce any UI, lettering, crowns used as UI icons, prices, buttons, status bars or watermarks from that screenshot.
Input image 2 is the MALE CHARACTER visual reference: preserve his recognizable hairstyle, hair color and facial character while creating a NEW close romantic scene.
Primary request: a premium female-audience romance-game illustration, emotionally intimate and captivating, understated sensual chemistry through affectionate eye contact, closeness and tender expressions. Two clearly adult people around 28 years old, fully clothed. The attractive adult man is the main visual lead, leaning slightly toward an adult woman shown in elegant partial profile, their faces very close and lips about to meet but not touching, reciprocal affection. No sexual activity.
Style/medium: beautifully rendered cinematic semi-realistic 3D otome-game key art, natural delicate skin texture, handsome refined facial anatomy, soft wavy hair, exquisite restrained finish, dreamy depth of field. Avoid flat anime line art or plastic doll skin.
Critical mobile layout: the finished image is a long vertical background, not a poster or UI mockup. BOTH faces, eyes, noses and the almost-kiss gesture must fit inside the CENTRAL 70 percent of image width and between 15 and 34 percent of image height, because the app header covers the top 15 percent and the membership cards cover the bottom 65 percent. Leave the top 10 percent as quiet darker atmospheric space, allow hair in the 10–18 percent band. Keep both faces large enough to read in that upper romantic window, with their heads turned in natural profiles. Below 38 percent of height, softly dissolve shoulders and clothing into a smooth low-detail deep aubergine/lavender atmosphere. The bottom 40 percent is a quiet dark violet field for actual app overlays, not a second illustration or a flat visible rectangle.
Lighting/mood: luminous lilac and mauve rim light, soft rosy skin highlights, brighter readable faces in the upper third, a few elegant amethyst refractions and defocused crystal glints near the outer edges inspired by image 1; gentle soft shadows and cinematic atmosphere, no glaring white light.
Color palette: lavender, smoky violet, muted rose and deep plum, with natural warm skin.
Constraints: single seamless image; no text, lettering, logos, numbers, borders, UI or watermark; anatomically natural faces and necks, no extra fingers or extra people. Fully opaque background. No explicit imagery, no adolescent appearance.
Character direction: the man from image 2 has textured muted wine-red hair, refined sharp features, a dark tailored jacket and softly loosened white collar. Replace his distant stern expression with affectionate focus on the adult woman he is close to. She has softly swept dark hair and wears an elegant dark dress. Delicate mauve and rosy lavender illumination. Do not copy the old low-angle camera, rope, hands pose or staircase; use a tender eye-level close portrait.

stages.label: 投影调整
stages.text:
Use case: lighting-weather
Edit this existing transparent dark-mode illustration. Preserve the peach glass gift box, tall pink bow, invitation letter with the gold round seal, and two wrapped candies. Keep the original muted peach and rose materials, their proportions and arrangement. Fit the entire group, slightly smaller and a little higher in a landscape 3:2 canvas, with a clear band under the objects for the shadow.

Give the gift a clearly visible physical grounding shadow cast by a large light source above-left. At each base start with a solid dark contact occlusion and carry a coal-plum cast shadow visibly down-right underneath the box and candy, softly tapering over the next 10–12 percent of the image height. The shadow must occupy the lower ground as a real shape, widening and fading outward, and be perceptibly darker than a muted dark gray-brown backing like #373033. Keep a tiny subdued warm reflection on the glass base. Avoid luminous floor pools or a mirror duplicate.

Keep the shadow itself in the alpha channel as a continuous semitransparent part of the sprite, with a visible dark core and soft edges. Everything above and around the subject and shadow is transparent. Leave transparent margins on all four sides, with the full projected shadow in frame. No floor slab, haze, white halo, background plate, text, logo, or new objects.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Image 1 is the actual transparent gift artwork to edit. Image 2 is the actual muted plum lighting and dark graphite canvas behind this artwork in the Yoroll app, for color and contrast reference only. Do not include Image 2 in the output.

Retouch only the ground contact under the exact gift box and two candies in Image 1. Keep their current scale, framing, exposure, glass, pink bow, cream letter, gold seal and position. Give the box and each candy a close soft occlusion where it touches the ground. Let those soft shadows merge into a short down-right cast shadow in dark warm plum, between #21151E and #32212D, so that the shadow picks up the same hue as the dark UI. Soften it progressively from the contact points outward. There is a very narrow muted rose glint along the real glass bottom edge only. Remove any cool gray fog or floor-like pale patch around the base. Avoid a heavy black contour or a blanket mirror effect.

Keep the shadow part of the transparent 3:2 RGBA art, with a translucent dark core and feathered edges. Fade to zero alpha around the edges, including completely clear space above the bow. Preserve the entire subject, and deliver just the object and its hue-matched shadow. No change to the artwork shape, no background, ground slab, opaque shadow island, diffuse exterior halo, text, or extra objects.
